title: CLI: print the request for an independent-review proposal; say "no version" for a versionless object (#170 item 3)
requirement:
Issue #170, item 3 only (internal/cli/cli.go). Items 1 and 2 of #170 are out of scope.

1. When `adc` receives a proposed command response whose policy is not human (an independent review), its human output must print what was requested, exactly as a human-policy proposal already does. Print a line `  requested: <action> <scope>` (two leading spaces; the action, one space, then the scope JSON exactly as sent) directly after the `proposed: <id> needs an independent review (binding <digest>)` line and before the `  effective: ...` line. Write it through `say`, like every human line, so a hostile scope is escaped exactly as on the human-policy path. The review proposal's human output is exactly these three lines. Each proposal's output contains exactly one `requested:` line, whatever its policy. An independent-review proposal still never mentions the dashboard and prints no `confirm at:` line.

2. In the `  effective: ...` line, an object with no version (`effective_change.object.version` is null) currently reads `at its digest`, naming a digest that is never shown. Print `at no version` instead. An object with a version still reads `at version <n>`.

3. `--json` output is unchanged: it stays the response itself, with no human lines.

No change outside internal/cli. No schema, generated-code, dependency or documentation change. The package's existing tests must stay green. Do not define identifiers starting with `TestAcceptQ7v` or `acceptQ7v`: they belong to the acceptance tests, which are overlaid on the package at gate time.
